skill.intro.role.accountant:
Press the skill-switch key (default Y) to toggle mode: Income and Expense.
Press the skill key directly to spend 175 coins and trigger the skill
Income: press the skill key while aiming at a player to see that player's most recent income source.
Income sources are one of: passive income, quest income, player kill income, pickpocketing, stealing, plundering, skill income, passbook income, other income, no income 
If that player has pickpocketed, stolen or plundered, that behavior is shown first 
Expense: mark a player, and 30s later you learn that player's coin spending channel.
skill.intro.role.accountant.simple:
Press the skill-switch key to toggle mode: Income and Expense
Triggering the skill costs 175 coins
Income: press the skill key while aiming at a player to see that player's most recent income source.
Pickpocketing, stealing and plundering are shown first.
Expense: mark a player, and 30s later you learn that player's spending channel.
skill.intro.role.admirer:
Use the skill to peek at the highlighted target and gain energy
At 90 you become the Manipulator.
skill.intro.role.admirer.simple:
Press the skill key to peek at the highlighted target and gain energy
When the bar is full you become the Manipulator
skill.intro.role.adventurer:
Press the skill key to place a waypoint; it vanishes after 3 minutes. 120s cd.
Waypoints vanish automatically after the game.
skill.intro.role.adventurer.simple: Press the skill key to place a waypoint (vanishes in 3 min, 120s cd).
skill.intro.role.agent:
Aim at a player and press the skill key to view their inventory interface.
If the player moves, the interface closes; 60s cooldown.
Staying crouched lets you sense nearby movement.
After the Conspirator guesses you, you learn the Conspirator's name and position.
skill.intro.role.agent.simple:
Aim at a player and press the skill key to spend 150 coin and view their inventory
You can crouch to see other players' footsteps
After the Conspirator guesses you, you learn their name and position
skill.intro.role.alchemist:
Press the skill-switch key (default Y) to switch the potion being brewed.
Press the skill key to spend 1 ingredient + the corresponding coin to brew a potion.
Each potion can be brewed twice; resets at game end.
skill.intro.role.alchemist.simple:
Press the skill-switch key to switch the potion being brewed
The cost and remaining brews are shown at the bottom-right
(See the detailed description for each potion)
skill.intro.role.amon:
Aim at a player within 4 blocks and press the skill key to plant a [Time Worm] in them — the victim gets no notice. Concurrent worms cap at total players/6.
Each worm lurks 75s, then the host is assimilated and can be inhabited by Amon, becoming a mature host.
With instinct on, all worm-marked players glow to you.
Click a mature host in your inventory to inhabit: you shrink greatly and slip inside them, following along but unable to control them. You must stay on them 60s, then sneak + skill key to usurp them. If the target dies, you return to where you inhabited.
On usurp, the host is killed (leaving an unidentified corpse) and you take their position, skin and name.
skill.intro.role.amon.simple:
After 60s on a host, sneak + skill key to usurp them
You inherit the host's position, skin and name as they die
On a lethal hit, consume a random host/backup to survive and return to that host's position
Near settlement, if you live with at least 1 backup, an 80-second [Find Amon] phase begins
During it, you gain others' items and must survive
skill.intro.role.anatman:
Skills (switch with the skill-switch key, cast with the skill key):
1. For Him: teleport Asatya back to his room. 80s cooldown.
2. Sacrifice: kill yourself (cause: run over by the train) and enter death penalty. 150s cooldown, starts at 180s.
3. Revive: spend 100 coins to revive Asatya. 120s cooldown.
skill.intro.role.anatman.simple:
Skills: For Him (teleport Asatya to his room, 80s cd), Sacrifice (kill self and enter death penalty, 150s cd, starts at 180s), Revive (100 coins to revive Asatya, 120s cd).
When Asatya dies, you enter 30s of Rampage.
Instinct only sees through Asatya (yellow outline).
skill.intro.role.asatya:
Skills (switch with the skill-switch key, cast with the skill key):
1. For Him: teleport Anatman to your side. 80s cooldown.
2. Sacrifice: kill yourself (cause: run over by the train) and enter death penalty. 150s cooldown, starts at 180s.
3. Revive: spend 100 coins to revive Anatman. 120s cooldown.
skill.intro.role.asatya.simple:
Skills: For Him (teleport Anatman to your side, 80s cd), Sacrifice (kill self and enter death penalty, 150s cd, starts at 180s), Revive (100 coins to revive Anatman, 120s cd).
When Anatman dies, you gain one shield (max 5).
Instinct only sees through Anatman (yellow outline).
skill.intro.role.athlete: Use the skill to gain Speed IV; 100-second cooldown
skill.intro.role.athlete.simple: Press the skill key to gain Speed IV
skill.intro.role.attendant:
Press the skill key to turn on lights within a 5-block radius (works even when lights are out)
When aiming at a player, you can see their room number.
Active skill — Light On: press the skill key to ignore conditions and turn on lights within 5 blocks
skill.intro.role.attendant.simple: Press the skill key to turn on nearby lights when they are out
skill.intro.role.barbarian: [Smoke Breath] (skill key): costs 100 coins, creates a 7s smoke cloud at your position. Players inside are blinded and can't use instinct see-through. 60s cd.
skill.intro.role.barbarian.simple: Skill: spend 100 coins for a 7s smoke cloud; those inside are blinded and lose instinct see-through, 60s cd.
skill.intro.role.bee_wasp: Can use the skill to poison players. Using it on a poisoned player kills them instantly.
skill.intro.role.bee_wasp.simple: Use the skill to poison players; using it on a poisoned player kills them instantly.
skill.intro.role.bee_worker:
Use the skill key to poison a player, but you die immediately.
A poisoned player dies if not cured within 20s.
Using the skill on a poisoned player kills them instantly.
skill.intro.role.bee_worker.simple:
Use the skill key to poison and kill a player.
Using the skill on a poisoned player kills them instantly.
skill.intro.role.better_vigilante:
Passive: Last Stand
You have no mood
When only 2 good players remain, you gain a Derringer and a grenade and unlock see-through.
Derringer: only reloads when it hits a player; 2-second cooldown; no cerebellum penalty.
skill.intro.role.blood_feudist:
The potion effects gained from the Vendettist's evolution must be toggled on/off manually with the skill key.
1 wrongful kill: permanent Speed I
2 wrongful kills: permanent Haste II
3 wrongful kills: instantly gain 150 coin
4 wrongful kills: permanent Speed II
5 wrongful kills: immune to all negative effects
skill.intro.role.blood_feudist.simple: Press the skill key to gain buffs
skill.intro.role.bomber: Exclusive skill - All the Way Up: press the skill key to buy a bomb; bought bombs go to the 3rd hotbar slot by default, one costs 100 coin
skill.intro.role.bomber.simple:
Pressing the skill key puts a bomb in your hotbar
The bomb explodes after a few seconds — pass it to another player (hold the bomb and right-click them).
skill.intro.role.boom_maniac:
Using the skill swaps your main-hand item to the off-hand; using it again swaps back
The Firework Crossbow kills players on direct hit and deals splash virtual damage to nearby players.
The Explosive Maniac's Firework Crossbow splash damage is lethal.
skill.intro.role.boom_maniac.simple:
Using the skill swaps your main-hand item to the off-hand
The Firework Crossbow kills players on direct hit and deals splash virtual damage to nearby players
The Explosive Maniac's splash damage is lethal
skill.intro.role.broadcaster.simple:
Press the skill key to spend 50 coin for a server-wide broadcast
Walkie-Talkie: right-click to join the channel; press Q to throw it to other players
skill.intro.role.builder:
Press the skill key to build a wall on the line perpendicular to your facing (4 long, 3 high, 1 thick); the wall vanishes after 25 seconds
Press the skill-switch key (default Y) to toggle build/remove mode
Build mode: press the skill key to build a wall, 45s cooldown, starts at 120s
Remove mode: press the skill key to remove the most recently built wall, no cooldown
Walls block all projectile entities (e.g. grenades, arrows, tridents; grenade-type throwables won't explode on hitting a Builder wall)
skill.intro.role.builder.simple:
Press the skill-switch key to toggle build/remove
Build mode: press the skill key to build a wall on the line perpendicular to your facing; vanishes after 25s
Remove mode: press the skill key to remove a built wall
Walls block all projectile entities (see details)
skill.intro.role.cake_maker:
Hold the smoker and press the skill key to deploy one at your feet for 40s, 60s cd.
Right-click in order: 3 wheat, wait 3s, add 1 egg and 2 sugar, wait 3s, add 3 milk buckets, wait 5s and the cake is baked.
Wrong order or waiting periods block adding ingredients.
Hold a cake and press the skill key to place it (vanishes after 40s).
Others right-click to eat: restores stamina and status bars (warmth/thirst/hunger), restores 30%% Sanity, and grants 12s Speed I and infinite stamina.
Each player can eat once per 30s; a cake serves up to 7 times.
skill.intro.role.cake_maker.simple:
Hold the smoker and press the skill key to deploy it
Add 3 wheat, wait 3s, 1 egg + 2 sugar, wait 3s, 3 milk, wait 5s to bake a cake.
Hold the cake and press the skill key to place it
skill.intro.role.candlebearer: Press the skill key to spend 1 stealth charge for 18 seconds of invisibility.
skill.intro.role.central_control:
Press the skill-switch key to cycle through the three skills below; each one has its own cooldown.
[Dynamic Module] Press the skill key to fit it to cameras inside the 15-block cone in front of you. Once fitted, drag the mouse on the camera feed to look around (up to ±90° horizontally and vertically). Cooldown 20s.
[Infrared Scanner] Costs 150 coins. The feed gains night vision, and only while you are actually watching this camera's feed does the infrared light illuminate the watched cone: players inside it who are not hidden get highlighted, so you can pin them down through the lens. The cone follows wherever you aim the camera; leave the feed or switch cameras and this camera's infrared goes dark immediately. Cooldown 90s.
[Laser Module] Costs 200 coins and can only be installed once per round. While viewing that camera, press the skill key to fire a laser along the crosshair. A hit player has their frenzy interrupted; otherwise they lose control for 5 seconds. Cooldown 120s.
While the cameras are offline you cannot install any module, and every installed module stops working.
Multiple modules can be stacked on the same camera, and all of them are cleared when a round starts or ends.
skill.intro.role.central_control.simple:
Press the skill-switch key to cycle the three skills; each has its own cooldown.
Dynamic Module: lets you drag the mouse to look around the camera feed
Infrared Scanner: night vision on the feed; only while you watch this camera does it light up the cone in view and highlight the players inside it, following wherever you aim
Laser Module: press the skill key on the camera feed to fire a laser at the crosshair
While the cameras are offline nothing can be installed and every module stops working
skill.intro.role.chef:
The Chef presses the skill-switch key to toggle between 【Food Plate】 and 【Drink Plate】.
The Chef uses the skill to place a food/drink plate at their feet (max 2 per match; plates persist until match end).
A food plate only holds 【cooked food】 and 【a pack of snacks】; a drink plate only holds 【a glass of water】; only the Chef can place items on them.
skill.intro.role.chef.simple:
Press the skill-switch key to toggle plate type; press the skill key to place a food/drink plate at your feet (only 2 uses per match)
Food plates hold cooked food and snacks; drink plates hold a glass of water; everyone may take (30s cooldown each)
skill.intro.role.cleaner: Using the skill clears dropped items in an area and plays a sound.
skill.intro.role.cleaner.simple:
Using the skill clears dropped items in an area
You can pick up guns
skill.intro.role.clockmaker:
Press the skill key to spend 125 coin and reduce game time by 45 seconds while speeding up world time by 2000 ticks.
Speeding up game time speeds up everyone's skill cooldowns.
Dealing with time, you ignore any time stop effects.
Game time can be reduced to a minimum of 1 minute 30 seconds.
skill.intro.role.clockmaker.simple:
Press the skill key to reduce time and speed up world time
You ignore any time stop effects
skill.intro.role.clone_doctor:
[Role Clone] (skill key): aim at a living player within 26 blocks. The target must be non-neutral and must have a role that other roles are allowed to randomly receive. Pressing the key starts a silent 1-second cast; the target, role, distance, and line of sight are re-checked when the cast ends. An interrupted cast does not start the cooldown.
On success you copy that role for 60 seconds: you only gain its abilities, your team does not change and you do not copy its appearance. For the first 10 seconds after copying you are invisible and cannot deal damage, and you cannot create substitutes during that time. The copied role keeps its normal skill key.
Cooldown is 30 seconds, starting when you return to Clone Doctor; both automatic expiry and an early return from the inventory give the full 30 seconds.
[Return to Clone Doctor]: while copying, a return button appears at the bottom center of your inventory; click it to end the copy early.
skill.intro.role.commander.simple:
Press the skill key to toggle the Killer channel; in it only the Killer team and the Magician can hear and see you
When instinct see-through is on, Sheriff-team players show a blue outline
skill.intro.role.conductor.simple: Skill: aim at a door, spend 125 coin, and after 5 seconds choose another room door to teleport to (90-second cooldown)
skill.intro.role.creeper:
Press the skill key to spend 300 coin and ignite yourself; after 6s you explode, killing yourself and players within 5 blocks.
After igniting, press the skill key again to spend 75 coin and detonate immediately, expanding the blast by 1 block.
When killed by a Revolver, you explode with a 5-block radius; if this blast hits more than 5 players, a second blast occurs 1 second later
skill.intro.role.creeper.simple:
Press the skill key to spend 300 coin and self-destruct; while ignited, spend 75 coin to detonate immediately with a larger blast
When killed by a Revolver you explode; if the blast hits more than 5 players, a second blast occurs 1 second later.
skill.intro.role.cuckoo:
Press the skill key to lay an egg (20s cooldown; may lay up to 2 more than the win target).
No egg may be laid within 10 blocks of another (3 on the Y axis).
Other players can destroy an egg by sneaking and looking at it within 3 blocks.
skill.intro.role.cuckoo.simple:
Press the skill key to lay an egg (limited number)
No egg within 10 blocks of another
Others can destroy an egg by sneaking and looking at it within 3 blocks
skill.intro.role.daiyousei: You can use the skill key to make a player skip a task.
skill.intro.role.daiyousei.simple: You can use the skill key to make a player skip a task.
skill.intro.role.daywalker:
Press the skill key to release the skill: it immediately consumes all stored "day-walk time" and fast-forwards the match time accordingly; the skill then enters a 150 second cooldown.
The skill can fast-forward the match time until only 5 seconds remain at most.
skill.intro.role.decree_mage: Press the skill key to open the decree vocabulary; click a word or type it exactly as listed. Opening the page costs nothing and starts no cooldown; coins are spent only after a decree is successfully issued. Initial cooldown: 80 seconds; cooldown after each successful decree: 65 seconds. Each decree can be used only once per round.
skill.intro.role.delayer:
Passive: when you kill a player, the game time is extended by 20 seconds.
Active: press the skill key to spend 75 coin and anchor your current state; the anchor lasts 20 seconds and then automatically rewinds. Taking non-forced damage forces an immediate rewind.
The rewind restores position, coin, and potion effects, but not inventory or item cooldowns.
The rewind is not a teleport — you smoothly travel back along the original path: your position is recorded every 2 seconds while anchored, and you are teleported back in reverse.
During the rewind your screen gets the same gray-white filter as time stop, while other players briefly zone out with a glass-shatter sound. 120-second cooldown.
Note: if you are hit while the anchor is still active (within 15 seconds), you are forced to rewind immediately and collapse to the ground, unable to move for 30 seconds.
skill.intro.role.delayer.simple:
The active skill costs 75 coin; the anchor lasts 15s then rewinds you back along the path (inventory is not restored)
Being hit during the anchor forces a rewind and leaves you prone, unable to move for 30s
When only 1 minute 25 seconds of time remains, 30 seconds of game time are added
skill.intro.role.dio:
During time stop, most players but you cannot move or use items.
The Clockmaker, Jotaro, and Sakuya can move during time stop.
You can see through Jotaro within 7 blocks (highlighted in gold, no need to enable instinct).
skill.intro.role.diver: The Diver can press the skill key to take off their gear
skill.intro.role.diver.simple: Press the skill key to take off your gear
skill.intro.role.doomed_sinner:
Skill 1 [Oracle of Fate]: aim at a player within 4 blocks and press the skill key to view their last 3 kills. 40s cd.
Skill 2 [Restart] (sneak + skill key): randomly pick a cause of death to die-escape — instantly return to your room, briefly invincible; this escape isn't recorded, doesn't advance progress, and doesn't trigger death checks. 75s cd.
skill.intro.role.doomed_sinner.simple:
Use the skill on others to see their last 3 kills
Sneak + skill: randomly die-escape back to your room; this death doesn't advance progress
skill.intro.role.doremy_sweet.simple:
The skill can spend coin to pick a player (not yourself) and weave a dream for them for 15 seconds.
After the dream ends, the player's state rewinds to before it began.
skill.intro.role.dream.simple: Skill key [Brew]: brew an invisibility potion (5s invisibility, can't attack or be hurt).
skill.intro.role.echo_listener:
Use a sound wave at a player, costing 50 coins, 30s cd; the hit glows 12s, can't use skills and gets Slowness II.
The closer a player is, the more they fear you: slight camera shake, Slowness, and accelerated Sanity drain.
Gain 5 coins every 5s, plus 50 per task.
skill.intro.role.embalmer: Press the skill key to randomly swap the skins of all players on the field and apply a random voice effect to everyone, lasting 30s (150s cd, starts at 150s).
skill.intro.role.embalmer.simple: Press the skill key to swap everyone's skins and apply a random voice effect
skill.intro.role.entity_null: Self erase: after selecting it with the skill switch key, release it within 0.5 seconds of being hit by a player. Once per match, the blast deletes players and dropped items within 4 blocks and kills you (it cannot be released when your death is forced).
skill.intro.role.exampler:
Active skill 1 - Exam:
Costs 100 coin; pick a player in the inventory to force them to take the exam. You must also complete the questions.
Players can spend 100 coin to cancel this death.
Active skill 2 - Everyone, Grind!
Everyone starts doing questions. Press the skill key to activate; costs coin. 240s cooldown.
Both skills share one cooldown.
Each player who dies from the forced exam grants you 1 energy.
After reaching 3 energy, you gain a Rampage Voucher and the energy resets.
skill.intro.role.exampler.simple: Press the skill key to spend 300 coin and make everyone start doing questions
skill.intro.role.fighter: Skill: Iron Body — press it to gain 2.5 seconds of invincibility. 2-minute cooldown.
skill.intro.role.fighter.simple:
Press the skill key for 2.5 seconds of invincibility.
Knuckles knock the target back and put their items on cooldown
skill.intro.role.furandoru:
Passive skills:
1. Finale Trigger
(1): when only you and one other team (not Neutral) remain, the time shortens to 120 seconds and the finale begins.
(2): if fewer than 90 seconds remain and the finale hasn't triggered, it triggers immediately.
2. Finale effect: during the finale, you glow for 60 seconds and hand wind bullets to all players. Each player gets (their coins / 75) wind bullets (min 1, max 16). At this point Killer kills no longer add time until Furandoru and Ghost die.
3. Concealment: for a set time you cannot be detected by normal Killer instinct.
skill.intro.role.futatuiwa_mamizou: Aim at a target and use the skill to view and buy items from their shop inside your own inventory (normal items only). The target's shop appears behind your Killer shop, priced at 150%% of their cost. Selection cooldown 60s.
skill.intro.role.futatuiwa_mamizou.simpl: You can pick a target; then use the skill to view and buy some items from their shop.
skill.intro.role.gambler: Draws a new role every 120s; choose with the skill key.
skill.intro.role.glitch_robot: The goggles can be Q-thrown to others; press the skill key to put them on / take them off.
skill.intro.role.glitch_robot.simple: Press the skill key to put them on / take them off
skill.intro.role.godfather: Skill: press the skill key at another player to recruit them into the family (as Mafioso, Family Soldier, Family Nanny, or Family Shield) (110s cooldown).
skill.intro.role.godfather.simple: Press the skill key to recruit others into the family (some roles can't be recruited)
skill.intro.role.hakurei_reimu: On flyable maps, press the skill key to fly briefly; on non-flyable maps you dash forward instead.
skill.intro.role.hakurei_reimu.simple: On flyable maps, press the skill key to fly briefly; on non-flyable maps you dash forward.
skill.intro.role.hata_no_kokoro:
Owns four masks — Joy, Anger, Sorrow, and Delight — worn with the skill key.
Other players cannot tell whether you wear a mask.
Masks have limited uses.
skill.intro.role.hata_no_kokoro.simple:
Owns four masks — Joy, Anger, Sorrow, and Delight — worn with the skill key.
Others cannot see your mask.
See the detailed description for mask details.
skill.intro.role.heng_xing_ti:
Permanently glowing. Use the skill to instantly start a 15s Orbit Field: during it you have 2 layers of timed shield, and the 8 nearest Passengers within 10 blocks are indiscriminately teleported around you; 240s cooldown.
Players attracted by you cannot use items or skills during this and are invulnerable.
If a player you attract accidentally falls into the void soon after (not by their own action and not caused by others), they return to their room.
skill.intro.role.heng_xing_ti.simple: Permanently glowing. Use the skill to instantly start a 15s Orbit Field: gain 2 layers of timed shield, and the 8 nearest Passengers within 10 blocks are teleported around you.
skill.intro.role.him:
Your skill toggles cloaking, cooldown 15 seconds. While cloaked you are invulnerable except to forced deaths.
While you are not cloaked, every player except him stares at you and cannot move their view.
skill.intro.role.hoan_meirin:
Press the skill key for 10s of Levitation II. 60s cooldown.
During this, press the skill key again to end it.
Can punch people (left-click).
Hitting the same person 5 times kills them. Has cerebellum penalty.
You start with one layer of Qi Shield.
Shields you gain from the Bartender are Qi Shields; when a Qi Shield breaks, it knocks back nearby people
skill.intro.role.hoan_meirin.simple:
Press the skill key for 10s of Levitation II; press again during it to end it.
Can punch people (left-click); hitting the same person 5 times kills them; has cerebellum penalty.
You start with one layer of Qi Shield.
Shields from the Bartender are Qi Shields; when broken, they knock back nearby people
If no one is within 5 blocks of you, you die of loneliness after 60s.
skill.intro.role.imitator:
Press the skill key at a living player to copy their skill (temporary skill, max 3 uses, copied ability cooldown 60s)
Press the skill-switch key (default Y) to switch skill slots
Can only copy skills from: Star / Recaller / Veteran / Broadcaster / Telegrapher / Athlete / Fighter / Ghost / Noisemaker / Singer / Glitch Robot / Clockmaker / Alchemist / Pilot / Painter / Builder / Accountant / Doctor
Apart from copied skills, all skill cooldowns are 90 seconds
Newly copied temporary skills overwrite old ones; when all 3 slots are full, devouring another corpse overwrites the earliest slot
Some skills are modified:
Singer skill: roots players within 4 blocks for 2 seconds
Glitch Robot skill: spawns a Slowness potion cloud at your feet
Alchemist skill: brews a dose of arsenic
Accountant skill: gain 100 coins
skill.intro.role.imitator.simple:
Press the skill key at a living player to copy their skill (temporary, max 3 uses)
Press the skill-switch key to switch skill slots
(See the detailed description for exact skill effects.)
skill.intro.role.infected:
Use the skill at a target to infect them.
Infected players die after 240 seconds; when the Plaguebearer dies, all infections clear.
Infected players spread the virus to 1 nearby player within 3 blocks every 50 seconds (max 1 per spread).
Killer team and Killer-side Neutrals can be infected but won't die from it.
Plague Time: instantly kills all infected players, instantly refreshes a cooldown, shortens skill cooldown to 3s, shortens spread interval to 10s; infecting everyone then helps the Killer team win.
Infection signs: infected players cough occasionally, sneeze when spreading, and the Plaguebearer's skill makes a syringe sound (same as using an antidote).
skill.intro.role.infected.simple:
Use the skill at a target to infect them; infected die after 240s and spread to 1 nearby player every 50s
Killers / Killer-side Neutrals don't die from infection
Plague Time: instantly kills the infected, greatly shortens cooldowns and spread interval; infecting everyone helps Killers win
Catalyst instantly kills the infected
Infection signs: coughing, sneezing on spread, syringe sound on cast
skill.intro.role.jade_general:
Press the skill key to [Flying Kick]: dash about 5 blocks along your aim, kicking open any doors along the way.
If you hit a target, knock them back 2 blocks — if they hit a block mid-knock, they're stunned 4s, else 2s.
Hits have a chance to give the target a permanent Slowness stack, stacking to Slowness III on repeat hits on the same target; more hits raise the chance (1%%->2%%->4%%->8%% cap).
Each Flying Kick empties your stamina bar; 35s cooldown.
skill.intro.role.jade_general.simple:
Press the skill key for a flying kick that can kick open doors along the way
Kicking a target knocks them back 2 blocks; if they hit a block they're stunned 4s, else 2s
Hits have a small chance of applying a permanent Slowness (stacks, max 3)
Each kick empties your stamina bar.
skill.intro.role.jojo.simple: Press the skill key to time stop for 5 seconds and, like the Clockmaker, you are immune to time stop.
skill.intro.role.kawashiro_nitori: While holding an item, press the skill key and aim at a player to force a trade; that player must pay you 200 coins.
skill.intro.role.kawashiro_nitori.simple: While holding an item, press the skill key at a player to force a trade; they must pay you 200 coins
skill.intro.role.kijin_seija: Active skill: give all players within an 8-block radius of you (except yourself) reversed controls for 15 seconds. During the effect, WASD and the mouse left/right buttons are swapped. 90-second cooldown.
skill.intro.role.kijin_seija.simple:
Use the skill to give all players within 8 blocks of you (except yourself) reversed controls for 15 seconds.
During the effect, WASD and the mouse left/right buttons are swapped.
skill.intro.role.kotiya_sanae:
Can spend 175 coin and use the skill key to pray for weather
Randomly casts one of the following:
- Clear Skies: everyone gets 10s of infinite stamina and Sanity regen; if lights are out, they immediately turn on.
- Downpour: everyone gets 10s of temporary shield.
- Gales: everyone gets 10s of Speed II
- Sandstorm: everyone loses see-through for 10s.
- Thunderflash: everyone glows for 10s.
- Haze: everyone cannot use items for 10s.
- Snowfall: everyone gets 10s of Slowness II
skill.intro.role.kotiya_sanae.simple:
Can spend coin and use the skill key to pray for weather.
See the detailed description for weather types.
skill.intro.role.lao_da: Active skill: Elbow Strike, elbowing nearby players away.
skill.intro.role.lao_da.simple: Active skill: Elbow Strike, elbowing nearby players away.
skill.intro.role.leather_pig:
Active · Rampage (skill key G): spend 150 coins for 30s of Rampage, highlighting all players within 40 blocks, gaining Speed III, and playing a mysterious chase sound.
45s cooldown.
skill.intro.role.leather_pig.simple: Press the skill key to spend 150 coins for 30s of Rampage: highlight all within 40 blocks + Speed III + chase sound
skill.intro.role.lender:
Use the skill on a player to make a loan offer; the player accepts by right-clicking you.
On accept, a contract page opens; fill in the amount (max 175 coins) and confirm; the filler receives a "loan contract" and the amount.
The Lender must hold enough coins to lend.
skill.intro.role.lender.simple:
Use the skill on a player to offer a loan; they accept by right-clicking you.
Max 175 coins; on signing, they get the contract and amount.
The Lender needs the coins on hand.
skill.intro.role.lin_family:
Skill 1 [Generous Gift] (skill key): spend coins to gift a currently see-through player. Killers randomly get a 3-durability knife (150 coins) or a 50%% dud one-time pistol (300 coins); good players may spend 200 coins for a 50%% dud one-time pistol that looks like a revolver.
If they decline, coins are refunded. 45s cd.
Skill 2 [Full Collector] (sneak + skill key): spend 400 coins to buy a random role item. 90s cd.
skill.intro.role.lin_family.simple:
Skill key: buy a knife or dud pistol for a see-through player.
Sneak + skill: spend 400 coins for a random role item.
skill.intro.role.maid_sakuya: Press the skill key to activate: time stops for 5s. If you kill someone during time stop, you also enter time stop.
skill.intro.role.maid_sakuya.simple: Press the skill key to stop time for 5 seconds
skill.intro.role.medium:
Press the skill key at a corpse and spend 150 coins to question the dead within 20 seconds.
The questioned dead is forced to their corpse and sees four answers: Yes, No, Don't know, Yes or No.
After they choose, the Medium learns the answer.
During questioning the Medium may speak to the dead, who can only answer via the options.
skill.intro.role.metal_monster:
Press the skill switch key to swap between your two skills.
Steel Coil Form: become a rolling steel coil. You start at speed 0.4 and accelerate as long as you hold forward, up to a maximum of 3. Let go and you keep rolling from momentum. You can turn at most 45 degrees at a time and lose speed while turning. Use A/D to steer left or right. Hitting a block wall bounces you back (hitting players does not), and you cannot accelerate during the bounce.
The coil fits through one-block-wide passages, but its impact covers two blocks.
Hitting a player deals 1 vanilla damage, knockback and virtual health damage. Below speed 1 there is no virtual health damage; every 0.1 above that adds 1 damage. This damage never cuts virtual health below 1 on its own.
At speed 1.5 you can smash open train doors as well as vanilla wooden and copper doors, without bouncing or losing speed.
Press the skill key again while rolled up to return to normal, resetting your speed and state and starting a 30-second cooldown.
Lethal Boost: for the next 2.5 seconds your impacts can cut a player's virtual health to zero and kill them, with the death reason steel coil crush.
120-second cooldown, and it starts on a 120-second cooldown at the beginning of the round.
skill.intro.role.missionary:
Click a player's avatar in your inventory to proselytize them, boosting their meeting vote weight (60s starting cd, 80s skill cd).
Proselytized players count as +1 vote (>24 alive: +2), stacking on their base weight.
Switching the target removes the bonus from the old one.
skill.intro.role.missionary.simple:
Open inventory and click a player's avatar to proselytize them
Boosts their meeting vote weight by +1 (+2 with >24 alive)
skill.intro.role.monitor: Use the skill key to mark a player and see-through their position.
skill.intro.role.monitor.simple: Use the skill key to mark a player and see-through their position
skill.intro.role.morphling:
Use the skill to change your skin — lasts 35 seconds — 20-second cooldown.
Press the skill key (G) to send a dummy holding a dagger that dashes forward along its initial facing; the dummy has no attack power and, if hit on the way, dissipates and spawns a flashbang in place. 90-second cooldown.
skill.intro.role.morphling.simple: Press the skill key to summon a dummy that walks forward; when shot down it releases a flashbang
skill.intro.role.mortician_bodymaker:
Skills (switch with the skill-switch key (default Y), shared cooldown):
Drag: press the skill key at a corpse to drag it; press again to drop it, 45s cooldown
Death Knell: reduces stamina of players within 5 blocks by 60%%, 60s cooldown
Wash: clears blood within 4 blocks, 45s cooldown
Corpse Maker: open inventory, click an avatar to create a fake corpse of that player at your position, 120s cooldown
Fake corpses are spotted by the Coroner and can be eaten by Vultures/Puppeteers; Amnesiac/Necromancer/Catgirl Summoner/Candle Bearer/Wayfarer cannot interact with them.
skill.intro.role.mortician_bodymaker.sim:
Press the skill-switch key to switch skills
Drag: press the skill key at a corpse to drag it; press again to drop it
Death Knell: reduces stamina of players within 5 blocks by 60%%
Wash: clears blood within 4 blocks
skill.intro.role.mushroom_scholar:
Within 3 blocks of a bed, press the skill key to open the "cultivate mushrooms" minigame: drag two differently colored potions onto the sample and run 3 experiments.
After an experiment, gain a non-toxic or toxic mushroom based on the process; mushrooms can be dropped with Q.
Non-toxic mushroom: 20s negative-effect resistance on eating
Toxic mushroom: 20s Glitch and Slowness I, plus 3s of no directional control.
Use the skill-switch key to switch to skill 2; hold a mushroom and press the skill key to brew it into mushroom extract, 90s cd.
Mushroom extract is throwable; on hitting a block or player, nearby players get the matching mushroom effect.
skill.intro.role.mushroom_scholar.simple:
Within 3 blocks of a bed, press the skill key to run a mushroom experiment, gaining non-toxic or toxic mushrooms.
Skill-switch to skill 2; press the skill key to brew a held mushroom, 90s cd
Brewed extract is throwable and applies the effect nearby.
(See details for effects.)
skill.intro.role.musician_phantom.simple: Press the skill key to spend 100 coins and teleport to a random player beyond 30 blocks
skill.intro.role.mustard: Teleport all your living puppets to your side, then for 30 seconds the first damage you take is redirected unchanged to the nearest living puppet; the puppet is not necessarily killed. Cooldown: 120 seconds. If you have no living puppet, the skill does not start its cooldown. Forced deaths and train deaths do not trigger this redirect.
skill.intro.role.mystia_lorelei:
Use the skill to open a rhythm game. Different rewards based on the score:
├─ Below 85: no reward
├─ Above 85: skip a task (25 coin reward)
└─ Above 95: pick randomly from:
   ├─ 1. Gain a grilled eel, throwable, eating grants Night Vision.
   ├─ 2. Within 5 blocks of yourself, everyone is continuously blinded and loses see-through (not including yourself) for 10s.
   └─ 3. Gain Speed II for 30s.
skill.intro.role.mystia_lorelei.simple: Use the skill to open a rhythm game and earn different rewards based on the score
skill.intro.role.nature_spirit: Skill [Leaf Hide]: press the skill key to disguise as the block under your feet; press again to end. 60s cd.
skill.intro.role.nature_spirit.simple: Press the skill key to disguise as the block underfoot; press again to end, 60s cd.
skill.intro.role.nianshou: Active - Scatter Wealth: every 2 tasks completed grants a Red Packet; use the skill on someone to send it, and after 15s they get a notice and 100 coin.
skill.intro.role.nianshou.simple: Every 2 tasks grants a Red Packet; use the skill on someone to send it, granting the target 100 coin
skill.intro.role.niaoshoushou.simple: Skill: place a 3x2 wall for 20s; refills every 60s, max 2 stored.
skill.intro.role.ninja.simple: Press the skill key for 2.5 seconds of shield that blocks one hit
skill.intro.role.noisemaker:
Using the skill quadruples your speaking range and ignores any voice-changing effects.
When triggered, the skill knocks back and stuns the player directly in front of you and makes everyone within 15 blocks (except the Noisemaker) glow.
skill.intro.role.noisemaker.simple: Using the skill widens your voice range, makes players within 15 blocks glow, and knocks back and stuns the player in front of you.
skill.intro.role.nostalgist:
You can press the skill key at any time to actively collapse the Netherworld and reveal yourself as a normal Killer (it collapses automatically when only you remain as a Killer).
Gain 100 coin when leaving the Netherworld.
skill.intro.role.nostalgist.simple: Press the skill key to leave the Netherworld; you cannot re-enter; on leaving you gain 100 coin and become a normal Killer
skill.intro.role.oldman: Sit in the wheelchair and press the skill key to stow it into the inventory.
skill.intro.role.oldman.simple:
Press the skill key to retract the wheelchair
May get a Carrot on a Stick; right-click to summon a pig you can ride
skill.intro.role.paper_doll:
Use the skill switch key to switch skills.
Paper blade: hold right-click for at least 0.05 seconds and release; it can only kill players within 5 blocks from behind an unobstructed target and cannot go through walls. A hit has a 12 second cooldown and a miss does not trigger the cooldown.
skill.intro.role.party_killer:
Click a player's avatar to cast the skill and give them the helium voice effect.
Each time the Party Killer casts, party sound effects play from the cast location 6 seconds later.
The helium voice lasts 4 minutes; skill cooldown 35 seconds.
skill.intro.role.party_killer.simple: Open your inventory, click a player's avatar to voice them with helium
skill.intro.role.pelican:
Skill: press the skill key to swallow living players within 2.15 blocks ahead.
Sneak + skill key: spit out the last swallowed player.
skill.intro.role.pelican.simple:
Press the skill key to swallow players ahead
Sneak + skill key: spit out the last swallowed player
skill.intro.role.phantom: Use the skill to go invisible; it does not hide items in hand and you keep your collision box while invisible
skill.intro.role.phantom.simple: Use the skill to go invisible
skill.intro.role.phantom_spirit:
Skill · Possess (60s cd): aim at a player and press the skill key to ride their head for 20s. During possession you can still use inventory items; the host gets Speed I. Can't possess invisible targets; if the host turns invisible, you dismount instantly.
During possession, press the skill key again to see-through all players within 10 blocks for 2s.
When the possessed player is killed, you die in their place.
Killers can't see through an unmounted Phantom, but can see one riding someone.
Killing a good player / being killed by one triggers cerebellum penalty.
skill.intro.role.pilot: The Pilot can buy a jetpack, elytra and firework rockets; press the skill key to remove the jetpack and elytra.
skill.intro.role.pilot.simple: Press the skill key to remove the jetpack and elytra
skill.intro.role.pooler: Use the skill switch key to cycle between the four skills.
skill.intro.role.psychologist:
With Sanity at 70+, use the skill on a player who must stay still; after ten seconds you refill their Sanity.
The skill also cures one random negative modifier on the target (curable: Paranoia, Manic, Hemophobia, Coward, Rage, Cowardice)
skill.intro.role.psychologist.simple: Press the skill key to refill a target's Sanity after ten seconds and cure one random negative modifier on them
skill.intro.role.pumpkin_spirit: Use the role skill key to become a real flying bat for 15 seconds, with a 30-second cooldown. Timers freeze while paused. Your exclusive shop sells only candy for 50 coins each. Another player eating candy you actually dropped grants you two pumpkins; eating it yourself grants none.
skill.intro.role.rabbit_wansui:
Use the skill to spend 25 coin and turn players on the train into Rabbits!
You can use the skill to become a Rabbit at any time.
skill.intro.role.rabbit_wansui.simple: Use the skill to spend 25 coin and turn players on the train into Rabbits!
skill.intro.role.recaller: Use the skill to mark a location; use it again to spend 100 coin and return to the marked spot
skill.intro.role.recaller.simple: Press the skill to set a marker; press again to spend 100 coin and return to it
skill.intro.role.return_traveler:
Has two switchable skills: Old Ferry and Last Train.
[Old Ferry]: after a 2s windup, pull yourself and the 2 nearest players within 4 blocks into the Other Side for 10s; after, you turn translucent for 15s and can't see/hear others.
[Last Train]: once per match, after a 2s windup, pull all players within 12 blocks (except yourself) into the Other Side for 30s, then you become a Civilian.
skill.intro.role.return_traveler.simple:
Has two switchable skills: Old Ferry and Last Train.
[Old Ferry]: pull yourself and the 2 nearest within 4 blocks into the Other Side for 10s; after, you're translucent for 15s and can't see/hear others.
[Last Train]: once per match, pull all within 12 blocks except yourself into the Other Side for 30s, then become a Civilian.
skill.intro.role.saigyouji_yuyuko: Use the skill key to devour corpses and players who stand idle for over 10 seconds.
skill.intro.role.saigyouji_yuyuko.simple:
Crouch + use the skill key to devour corpses.
You can long-press the skill to devour eligible players.
skill.intro.role.salted_fish:
Press the skill key to lie facing the sun; you can't move, turn, use items or open inventory.
Lasts up to 80s; every 20s you pop up and flip over.
The 40s cooldown only starts after the duration ends.
skill.intro.role.salted_fish.simple: Press the skill key to lie facing the sun for 80s, popping up and flipping every 20s
skill.intro.role.sea_king: Skill: press the skill key to give players in water within a 20-block radius 5 seconds of Weaving and Glowing.
skill.intro.role.sea_king.simple: Press the skill key to give players in water within a 20-block radius Weaving and Glowing
skill.intro.role.silencer:
Open the skill page and click a player's avatar to cast; the target enters these stages in order
Stage 1 - Mute: the muted player cannot speak and their chat messages aren't received by others, lasting 45s; the muted player is notified
Stage 2 - Plea: lasts 30s; the voice mute ends but they still can't use chat. They must find another player to right-click you to lift the curse. If no plea succeeds within 30s, enter Stage 3.
Stage 3 - Punishment: players who fail to plea trigger a global sound, have all Sanity and stamina drained, and all Silencers gain 120 coins
When 2 or fewer Civilians remain, your skill skips the plea and punishment stages
Skill cooldown 130s; starts at 155s at match start
skill.intro.role.silent_killer: Skill: Grand Entrance. Effect: when your balance is below 5, you can trigger this skill to kill everyone within 2.5 blocks (including the Killer team, up to 5 people).
skill.intro.role.silent_killer.simple: Skill: Grand Entrance. Effect: when your balance is below 5, you can trigger this skill to kill everyone within 2.5 blocks (including the Killer team, up to 5 people).
skill.intro.role.spellbreaker:
Press G to unleash an anti-magic field: non-Killers within 50 blocks cannot use skills or open their inventory for 30s and gain a Wonderland filter.
Under this filter, players in water are fully blacked out.
Anti-Magic Potion: use on a player to make their next skill attempt fail and lock skills for 30s (45s duration).
Silence Totem: throw a hidden totem; for 30s non-Killers within 6 blocks keep Slowness I and Blindness. Only one totem at a time.
skill.intro.role.spellbreaker.simple:
Press the skill key to stop non-Killers within 50 blocks from using skills/inventory and give them a Wonderland filter.
Under the filter, players in water are fully blacked out.
Anti-Magic Potion: makes the target's next skill fail and locks skills for 30s
Silence Totem: thrown to give non-Killers within 6 blocks Slowness I and Blindness
skill.intro.role.star:
Using the skill makes everyone within 30 blocks look at you and glow for two seconds.
You can see how many nearby people are looking at you.
Each person looking at you grants 10 coin, up to 150 coin.
skill.intro.role.star.simple:
Using the skill makes nearby people look at you; the more people, the more coin you earn
Autograph Paper can be signed; those with it see your position and gain Speed I while looking at you
Life-and-Death Pact: hold Autograph Paper, crouch + right-click to sign it; you take a lethal hit for whoever holds the pact.
skill.intro.role.star_gatherer:
The skill switch key cycles between three skills:
Sanctuary boost: the halo's protection expands to a 10 block radius for 30 seconds.
Star gravity: usable only twice per match; after channelling for 5 seconds it pulls all metal items out of the hotbars of non-passenger players within a 16 block radius (each pull discards surplus duplicates).
Alms: aim at a player and release to hand your metal items over to them (tridents and the dream iron axe are excluded).
skill.intro.role.steve:
Press the skill key or consume a piston to build a wall lasting 25 seconds, sharing a 45-second cooldown between the two.
Eating a golden apple grants a 20-second weak shield that only blocks knives.
skill.intro.role.swapper:
Triggering the skill has a 2.5s delay during which the Swapper cannot move.
Pressing the skill swaps positions with the target directly in front of you.
The Swapper cannot swap someone while falling.
The swapped player receives a notice.
skill.intro.role.swapper.simple: Press the skill key to swap positions with the target directly in front of you
skill.intro.role.swordsman:
[Blood Quench]
Press the skill key to drain 50%% virtual health (based on max, never below 1; can't cast at 1)
Lasts 15s: katana virtual damage x2, gain Speed 2 and Haste 2
Casting also grants 20 virtual shield: topped up to 20 if below, higher shields are kept as-is
This shield does not vanish when the skill ends
skill.intro.role.tartaglia:
Skill [Art of Extremity · Perishing Flash]: while holding a bow or crossbow, use the skill to dash forward as a bolt of lightning, killing up to 2 players in your path.
Bow cooldown is 5s; crossbow is 1s.
skill.intro.role.telegrapher:
You can press the skill key to open the telegraph interface and send an anonymous message to all players.
At most 6 telegrams can be sent per match.
The telegram is voice-broadcast and shown as a title on every player's screen.
skill.intro.role.telegrapher.simple:
Press the skill key to open the telegraph page and send a title broadcast to all players
Only 6 uses per match
skill.intro.role.the_fool:
The Fool can hold a Tarot Meeting while alive or dead (6 min cooldown while alive, 8 min after death)
The meeting lasts 60 seconds; press G to settle the vote early
Members press J to join or open the vote screen
All attendees may vote for any non-Fool player, including the dead
On a tie, no votes, or if the top-voted player is already dead, the Fool receives a one-time pistol
If the top-voted player is alive, they are locked as the Heretic after voting; the Fool is immune to one hit from the Heretic
The Executioner's Pistol can only execute the current Heretic; firing at others just clicks empty
Spiritual Cloak: gain 5 seconds of invincibility but cannot attack others
skill.intro.role.the_fool.simple:
The Fool can hold a Tarot Meeting while alive or dead
Players press J in the meeting to open the vote screen
Attendees vote for any non-Fool; the top vote becomes the Heretic
If the Heretic is already dead when voted, the Fool gets a one-time pistol
The Executioner's Pistol can only kill the Heretic; the Fool is immune to one hit from the Heretic
Spiritual Cloak: 5 seconds invincibility but cannot attack
skill.intro.role.thief:
Press the skill-switch key (default Y) to switch modes: Steal Coin, Steal Item, Sell Item; press the skill key while aimed at a player to use (skill cooldown 30s; failed steals do not trigger cooldown; selling has no cooldown)
When the Thief's coin reaches a threshold (total players at game start × 55 coin), the money automatically converts into Gold Ingots.
Each coin steal takes 40%% of the target's coin (minimum 100 coin); if the target has fewer than 100 coin, you cannot steal; the robbed player loses the corresponding coin.
Each item steal takes a random item from the target's inventory (cannot steal letters, food, drinks, or Civilian-team pistols).
The Thief's sell mode sells the item in hand for 50 coin.
Each player the Thief kills grants 200 coin.
skill.intro.role.thief.simple:
Press the skill-switch key to switch modes: Steal Coin, Steal Item, Sell Item
Killing players grants 200 coin
Steal Coin: rob players with more than 100 coin, taking a proportional amount
Steal Item: steal items from others' inventories
Sell Item: sell the item in hand for 50 coin
skill.intro.role.trapper: The skill key deploys the current trap (press the skill-switch key, default Y, to switch type); placement has a 1-second wind-up (you cannot move during it); Tripwire and Quagmire have independent cooldowns (35s each); at most 5 of both traps can exist at once.
skill.intro.role.trapper.simple:
Press the skill key to place a trap (1-second wind-up, cannot move); use the skill-switch key to change type
Tripwire: placed on walls; stepping on it slows greatly; only removed by gunfire; Civilians see only the wall anchor
Quagmire: 25 coin each; on trigger, entangles nearby players for 6 seconds
skill.intro.role.veteran:
While holding the knife, press the skill key to dash about 2 blocks forward based on your current movement direction; 60-second cooldown.
Using the knife triggers Jester Rampage but does not consume the knife's use.
skill.intro.role.veteran.simple: Hold the machete and press the skill key to dash forward
skill.intro.role.voice_changer:
Crouch + skill key: mark the player under your crosshair (the target gets no notice; can mark multiple; 20-second cooldown per mark).
Skill key: apply the currently selected voice-changing effect to all marked players (lasts 60 seconds; 60-second cooldown).
Skill-switch key: switch voice-changing type; crouch + skill-switch key: switch voice-changing level (max level 5).
Players afflicted with a voice effect get a broadcast notice telling them which effect was applied.
skill.intro.role.voice_changer.simple:
Crouch + skill key: mark the player under your crosshair; can mark multiple.
Skill key: apply the selected voice-changing effect to all marked players.
Skill-switch key: switch type; crouch + skill-switch key: switch level (max 5).
Afflicted players get a notice.
skill.intro.role.vulture:
Use the skill to eat corpses; eaten corpses' info is erased (the Coroner sees garbled text)
You must eat one corpse per six people
After eating a corpse you get gray particle effects, so please don't eat corpses in public
After reaching the required count you become a random Killer
After becoming a Killer you inherit the Vulture's coin: 40%% + 100.
skill.intro.role.vulture.simple:
Press the skill key while aimed at a corpse to eat it
After eating a certain number of corpses you become a random Killer role.
skill.intro.role.warlock:
Press the skill key [Steal Flesh]: aim at a player to steal a Hex Vessel (once per player per match). On cast a particle effect plays and the target is notified.
[Bone-Eating Curse] (Y to switch, 45s cd): consume a Vessel to curse its owner — target is briefly isolated (can't see/hear others), slowed, and loses 30%% San; they're marked [Cursed] for 45s. If the target dies during the curse (any cause, any killer), you gain 40 coins and can unlock [Domain Expansion: Grey Marrow Realm] in your inventory.
[Domain Expansion: Grey Marrow Realm] (open inventory, pick a cursed living target, 60s cd): drag them and your true body into a high-altitude grey-mist ritual ground for 25s; on entry the target gets Darkness/Blindness and can't use skills. Inside you gain speed and may hunt freely with a knife; others get a grey-white filter.
The dragged target kills you to break the domain immediately; when time ends all survivors return the way they came, and corpses inside are returned to the dead player's position.
skill.intro.role.warlock.simple:
Skill 1: steal a Hex Vessel from a player (once each); particles and a notice on cast.
Skill 2 (Y to switch): spend a Vessel to curse the target — brief isolation + slowness -30%% San; if they die during the curse you gain 40 coins and unlock skill 3.
Skill 3: open inventory, pick a cursed living target to drag into a domain (60s cd); on entry they get Darkness/Blindness and can't use skills
skill.intro.role.watcher:
Press the skill key to toggle between Serene and Wrath; 30-second cooldown.
In Wrath Pose you lose the shield, continuously gain Speed I, and unlock Killer abilities.
If you personally kill a player in Serene Pose, you die immediately.
skill.intro.role.watcher.simple:
You have two states, toggled with the skill key
Serene state: one layer of shield; you are treated as a good player (cannot pick up guns, but would trigger wrongful-Civilian-kill death); if you try to kill a player in Serene state, you die.
skill.intro.role.water_ghost: Skill: press the skill key for 10 seconds of Dolphin's Grace I, 40-second cooldown
skill.intro.role.water_ghost.simple:
Press the skill key for 10 seconds of Dolphin's Grace
The Water Ghost dries out and dies after 35 seconds on land
skill.intro.role.wind_yaose: Active skill: lowers the volume of nearby players to 5%%
skill.intro.role.wind_yaose.simple: The skill lowers the ambient volume to 5%%
skill.intro.role.wizard:
Press the [skill-switch] key to switch spells, the skill key to cast the current spell; the shop also offers quick-cast entries for all spells (priced at 0 coins, actually costing mana), clickable without switching the wheel:
· Stoneskin: can't cast below 200 mana; once per match, not on yourself, consumes all mana and gives the target a 120s timed shield; on success the staff enters knife cooldown.
· Frost Shock: can't cast below 200 mana; consumes half current mana and freezes everyone nearby except you from moving or turning their view.
· Shrouding Darkness: only during lights out, costs 150 mana, extends Darkness by 6s for everyone except the Killer team.
· Explosion!: requires at least 400 mana; on cast deducts 85%% of current mana and replaces the staff's next attack with a wall-piercing 9th-tier fireball (area damage, max 3 kills).
· Flash Step: costs 80 mana (15s cd), blinks up to 8 blocks along your aim, landing early into walls.
skill.intro.role.wizard.simple:
Switch spells with the skill-switch key; quick-cast in the shop (costs mana)
Stoneskin: once per match, temp shield on a player, consumes all mana, needs 200 mana
Frost Shock: freeze all others from moving/turning, half mana, needs 200 mana
Shrouding Darkness: only during lights out, 150 mana, extends Darkness 6s for non-Killers
Explosion!: next attack becomes a wall-piercing fireball, max 3 kills, needs 400 mana, costs 85%% mana
Flash Step: blink up to 8 blocks, 80 mana
skill.intro.role.yakumo_yukari: Toggle the portal on/off with the skill.
skill.intro.role.yakumo_yukari.simple:
Toggle the portal on/off with the skill.
Any player can pass through the portal to reach the other side.
Players who pass through are immune to sourced-less environmental damage for 30s.
Each player has a cooldown for using the portal.
The portal is visible only to the Killer team and independent neutrals.
skill.intro.role.youlu: 【Soul Wander】(skill key): the camera enters free mode (your body stays put, movement keys control the camera, ESC cancels); press the skill key again to condense a 12-second ball of smoke at the camera position — players inside have black fog vision; 45-second cooldown.
skill.intro.role.youlu.simple: 【Soul Wander】: press the skill key for a free camera; press again to condense a 12-second smoke ball at the camera; 45-second cooldown.
skill.intro.role.zhang_angel: Skill · Call Lightning: aim at a player and press the skill key, spending 10 drains and 100 coins to strike them. They randomly get one of: Slowness II (2 min), Blindness + Blind Sight (30s), Deafness (30s), Limp (30s).
skill.intro.role.zhang_angel.simple: After 10 drains, spend 100 coins at a target to call lightning, giving a random effect: Slowness II / Blindness + Blind Sight / Deafness / Limp.
